task_metadata_exposure_before_v2_lock.scope: The official task file was processed to construct membership. Inventory-level membership counts and one protected Hiroshima pixel_annotated example were surfaced during independent audit.
task_metadata_exposure_before_v2_lock.effect_on_design: None: inventory allocation, salted filename selection, arms, endpoints, thresholds, and confirmation conditions were already fixed and do not use pixel_annotated.
task_metadata_exposure_before_v2_lock.claim_constraint: The experiment may claim protected NetCDF and model-outcome holdout, not complete protected-outcome-metadata blindness.

license: CC BY 4.0; underlying Sentinel-2 data use Copernicus Sentinel terms
previously_accessed_modality: Sentinel-1 ascending NetCDF; the static MASK outcome is shared across modalities and therefore counts as outcome access
prohibited_actions_before_public_lock: Extract or open any protected Sentinel-2 NetCDF file
Read any protected MASK variable, label statistic, prevalence, or model outcome
Change protected inventory membership using imagery, labels, dates, or performance
selection_basis: Set difference between the 13 inventories in the pinned official S12LS-LD harmonized Sentinel-2 task-membership union and every inventory with documented prior static-mask access. Protected NetCDF, MASK arrays, imagery, model predictions, and model performance were not accessed; limited upstream task-definition metadata exposure is disclosed separately.

current_campaign_development_access.v3_fit_gate: failed: 21 China-held-out validation F1 values ranged from 0.0216 to 0.0520 against an every-run 0.25 floor
current_campaign_development_access.v4_development_use: deterministic mixed-inventory calibration split selected after disclosed development-only exploration

limitations: An inventory can contain multiple trigger dates; inventory is used as the conservative independence unit.
Some event dates were NDVI-assisted; a predeclared high-confidence-date sensitivity is required.
The supplied random patch split is invalid for event/site inference and will not be used.
